class.description: Publishes a goal pose to /goal_pose topic and blackboard. Reads x, y, yaw from XML parameters and creates a PoseStamped message.

Generates a dense straight-line path from the current TF pose to a goal (goal_x, goal_y, goal_yaw), with yaw interpolated only in the middle segment: keeps start_yaw until rotation_start_distance from start, then linearly rotates toward goal_yaw until rotation_end_distance from goal, then keeps goal_yaw. rotation_direction selects 'cw' or 'ccw'. Sends the path to controller_server's FollowPath action, bypassing the global planner. For the robot to actually rotate during motion, the MPPI controller must have PathAlignCritic.use_path_orientations = true.

Sends multiple goal poses to the nav2 NavigateThroughPoses action server, so the global planner stitches them into a single continuous path (ComputePathThroughPoses) and the controller follows it without stopping at intermediate waypoints. Port "poses" is a string like "x1,y1,yaw1; x2,y2,yaw2; ..." (meters, radians). Only the FINAL pose's yaw is enforced by goal_checker; intermediate yaws are not strict.

Publishes a small Twist on the navigation velocity topic at a fixed rate (publish_rate_hz) for a short duration so swerve wheels can pre-align before stair climb/descend. Sends a zero Twist when finished or halted.
Updates inflation_layer.inflation_radius and inflation_layer.cost_scaling_factor on nav2 local/global costmap nodes at runtime via the SetParameters service.
Sets selected nav2_mppi_controller parameters on controller_server at runtime (parameter names plugin_prefix.key, e.g. FollowPath.batch_size) via SetParameters.

Sends robot_interfaces/ArmTask action goal. Tries TF first (base_frame to target_frame); if TF times out, uses cube_x/cube_y/block_height (in map_frame) and the live base_frame to map_frame TF to compute the cube pose in base_frame, then appends grasp_height.

Sends robot_interfaces/ArmTask for joint-space move (default task_id=1): ports j1..j6 (rad). If duration_sec is negative (default), goal.data has 6 values (arm_task uses trajectory_duration). If duration_sec is non-negative, appends duration as 7th value.
Sends robot_interfaces/ArmTask for joint-space move (default task_id=1) using a named pose looked up in arm_task/config/arm_position.yaml (port "name").

Subscribes to a robot_interfaces/Plan topic (transient_local) and stores the latest plan into the blackboard. Stays RUNNING until the first message arrives; outputs num_steps for use by a Repeat decorator.

Pops the front PlanStep from the shared plan vector and writes its fields into independent blackboard keys (step_type, target_id, from_id, prep_x/y/yaw, abs_dh, stair_dir, cube_x/y, block_height). Returns FAILURE when empty.

Reads (without popping) the front PlanStep of the shared plan vector and writes selected fields with `next_*` prefix (next_step_type, next_from_id, next_target_id, next_cube_x/y, next_block_height). Returns SUCCESS even when the plan is empty (next_step_type = "NONE").

Reads block_blue.yaml + arm_ready_position.yaml and computes the named arm preparation pose for an upcoming PICK based on (next_from_id, next_target_id). The arm only reaches to the body's left, so when the target is on map +y (dy > 0) and a `pick_left_` exists in arm_ready_position.yaml it is preferred; otherwise falls back to `pick_front_`. Suffix is decided by round(dh / 0.2): +1 → up200, +2 → up400, -1 → down200, -2 → down400. Outputs the chosen name into arm_prep_name; FAILURE if neither candidate exists.

Condition node. Reads current map->base TF and compares to (target_x, target_y, target_yaw); returns SUCCESS only when |dx|, |dy| and the wrapped yaw error are all within their tolerances. Used to skip the navigation-to-prep-pose step when the robot is already there.

Condition node. During navigation, reads current map->base TF and /AT_R2/distance (std_msgs/Float64). Returns SUCCESS only when the current y range, yaw tolerance, and scaled distance range from XML ports are all satisfied for stable_count consecutive ticks.

Servo-aligns the robot to a target /AT_R2/distance value using proportional cmd_vel control. The published linear velocity axis is selectable from XML, with an optional y-axis side press velocity scaled from the main speed.

Publishes an integer command (std_msgs/Int32) on a topic (default /AT_R2/head_gripper_cmd, latched) to drive the independent weapon-head gripper: 1=prepare grasp, 2=grasp, 3=dock. When wait_done is true it subscribes to done_topic (default /AT_R2/head_gripper_done) and stays RUNNING until the feedback value equals the sent command, or fails after timeout seconds (timeout<=0 = wait forever).

Publishes an integer (std_msgs/Int32) on a topic (default /AT_R2/zone_mode, latched) to switch the robot working-zone mode: 1=zone 1 (grasp weapon head / dock), 2=zone 2 (climb stairs / grasp blocks), 3=zone 3 (reserved). Synchronous: publishes and returns SUCCESS immediately.
Waits for the operator to press Enter before continuing the behavior tree. Useful to pre-run setup nodes before a competition start signal, then release navigation immediately from the terminal.
